name: current-base-dom-local-runtime-001-api67
notes: Current-base lane retains the enum constants; inherited value semantics and XML reader accessors are transferred to core-runtime-dom-xmlreader-value-contracts-wave19-runtime.
salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce API 67 does not permit constructing dom.XmlNode; this is a local runtime contract.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseDomLocalRuntime001Test { @isTest static void domLocalRuntime001Witness() { dom.Document documentValue = new dom.Document(); System.assertEquals(documentValue, documentValue); System.assertNotEquals(null, documentValue.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, documentValue.toString()); dom.XmlNode nodeValue = new dom.XmlNode(); System.assertEquals(nodeValue, nodeValue); System.assertNotEquals(null, nodeValue.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, nodeValue.toString()); dom.XmlNodeType commentValue = dom.XmlNodeType.COMMENT; dom.XmlNodeType textValue = dom.XmlNodeType.TEXT; System.assertEquals(commentValue, commentValue); System.assertNotEquals(null, commentValue.hashCode()); System.assertEquals(2, commentValue.ordinal()); System.assertEquals(commentValue, dom.XmlNodeType.valueOf('COMMENT')); System.assertEquals(true, dom.XmlNodeType.values().size() > 0); System.assertNotEquals(null, textValue); } }
